program = '''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    base = max(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if any(row))
    for c, value in enumerate(grid[base]):
        if value in (2, 8):
            height = 4 if value == 2 else 3
            for offset in range(1, height + 1):
                r = base - offset
                if r >= 0:
                    out[r][c] = value if offset == height else 1
    return out
'''
